title: Undertow
pitch: Inverted fishing: you are the fish, and the endgame is biting the hook on purpose to drag the fisherman into the water.
howto: Strip bait off dangling hooks and eat smaller fish to grow through five size stages, darting away whenever the line flashes its red yank warning. Once you outweigh a boat's tier, BITE its hook and win the tug-of-war to dunk its fisherman. Pearls from bait, dunks and leftover biomass buy a persistent evolution tree that unlocks deeper, richer zones.
controls: Hold anywhere to swim toward your finger. Tap fast to thrash off a hook. Hold to pull in the tug-of-war and let go on the red heave. Tap BITE THE HOOK when it appears.
